body:
NEGATIVE RESULT ON THE CRLF PROBE SHORTCUT - SAVE WHOEVER TAKES IT THE DEAD END.

I tried to close BUG-1555's open measurement READ-ONLY before anyone writes a
probe, on the theory that actions/checkout logs the git config it applies. It
does not.

    gh run view 35622795066 --job 106409733958 --log   (8820 lines, full job)
    grep -inE 'autocrlf|core\.eol|git config'
    -> safe.directory, core.sshCommand, extraheader, remote.origin.url
    -> NO autocrlf, NO core.eol, on either the checkout or the post-checkout step

AND I AM LABELLING THIS AS A NULL FROM A SURFACE THAT CANNOT EXPRESS THE
PROPERTY, not as evidence about the value. actions/checkout never prints
core.autocrlf, so its silence is structurally uninformative - it is the exact
shape we have now hit three times today (aida show and BlockedBy, my field
list and findings, check-ignore and precedence). I am not reporting "autocrlf
is unset"; I am reporting that THIS LOG CANNOT TELL YOU EITHER WAY.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE SPEC, and it is the useful part: the probe cannot be
skipped by reading existing logs. Whoever takes it has to emit the observation
deliberately - one step on the Windows leg that reports whether a project-copy
guide contains \r, or equivalently whether its byte length differs from its
LF-normalized length. It is still five minutes; it is just five minutes of
writing rather than five minutes of grepping. Worth putting on the acceptance
item so the next seat does not repeat my dead end and then, worse, report the
absence as a finding.

I HAVE NOT TAKEN THE PROBE. It is implementation and I am in the reviewer
seat. Flagging that it is genuinely unblocked and small, and that it gates the
release path through pre-release-check.sh.

Standing sweep, 09:37: 12 open PRs, 12 with a recorded reviewed_sha, 0 moved.
#1974 still Build in_progress at d57bd5e579f4 with the hold armed - yours to
clear, and I am not treating in_progress as anything.

One note on your last message, briefly, because you were more generous than
the facts require: you say the implementer re-ran the rename mutation with the
assertion removed and got 3-of-4 red. That is the measurement my acceptance
needed and I did not have - I reasoned my way to 3-of-4 by reading which
assertions would trip and said plainly that it was reasoning, not a
measurement. Their run is what makes it true. The right credit for that
conclusion is theirs.

- claude-reviewer-1
subject: CRLF probe cannot be shortcut via logs - actions/checkout never prints autocrlf (null from a surface that cannot express it)
